'''Logray's ceremonial wand''' was an artifact that allowed its possessor to practice [[Magic/Legends|magic]], and was used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was broken when the [[Wokling/Legends|young]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] tried to use it without Logray's permission, sometime around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].

==Characteristics==
Ceremonial [[magic wand]]s were used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. One such wand belonged to [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. It was made of a single piece of wood, approximately the size of an Ewok's [[Limb/Legends|arm]], adorned with three feathers and a bright [[Color/Legends|white]] marble. With the artifact, a mere apprentice was able to make a [[Flute/Legends|flute]] dance on the wind and play a tune. The wand also allowed its user to conjure puffs of prism powder that zoomed in the air like miniature [[Comet/Legends|comets]].<ref name="SSEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Come on, girls! Let's get away from this guy and his crazy magic!|Wicket W. Warrick|<ref name="SSEA" />}}
Logray's ceremonial wand belonged to Logray, an old Ewok who served as the head shaman of Bright Tree Village<ref name="SSEA" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="SWBTM" /> the young [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]]&mdash;Logray's new apprentice&mdash;once borrowed the wand without his teacher's permission. He wished to practice magic in the [[Tree/Legends|forest]], in hopes of impressing his friends [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]]. As Teebo was not a properly trained magician, his spells went wrong quickly. The conjuring of small comets went out of control, causing [[Latara's flute]] to fall on the ground and break.<ref name="SSEA" /> Logray's magic wand was also broken in the process.<ref name="SSVSS">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref>

Following this event, Teebo and his friends were lured into the den of [[Morag]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]]. Logray came to the rescue of the young Ewoks and gained the upper hand over Morag, with the help of Teebo. When the battle was over, the old shaman first blamed Teebo for abusing magic, ruining his ceremonial wand and putting the life of his friends in danger. But Logray also recognized his apprentice had relied on himself to get out of trouble as he had been taught, which prompted Logray to forgive Teebo.<ref name="SSVSS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Logray's wand was created for "[[Sunstar vs. Shadowstone]]," the ninth episode of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated television series<ref name="SSVSS" /> that aired on [[November 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
